name: PolyDEX PLX Locker (vMToken) claimUnlocked ERC777 reentrancy
summary: vMToken.claimUnlocked transfers the claimable PLX before increasing _released. PLX calls the recipient's ERC1820 tokensReceived hook, so the attacker's contract locked PLX, unlocked and re-entered claimUnlocked 40 times per transaction, being paid the same vested amount each time; eleven transactions with growing locks drained the locker.
notes: Reset: the proxy's initialize() 74 blocks after deployment set the plx token pointer (slot 0x98, empty in proxy storage until then) and the release schedule the exploit needed; the later fee exclusion for the locker on PLX only sized the transfers.
PLX is valued at the attacker's disposal (25 sales returning 127,336.87 USDC.e plus 119.24 WETH swapped for 266,831.66 USDC.e), which crashed the price; PolyDEX reported about 500,000 USD.
Campaign: the only transactions with more than two PLX transfers out of the locker in one transaction are these eleven, all from the attacker EOA.
